_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: I can't promise to love you perfectly, but I can promise to love you endlessly. I have loved you through every version of us, and every life we've never lived. Even the stars burn until nothing remains, but I love you endlessly.
